content.text:
Repaired the implementation under `src/` while preserving the public API.

- Scoped request identity to `(tenant, requestId)` using collision-safe keys.
- Combined duplicate SKU quantities and sorted items deterministically.
- Staged stock changes on a copy so failed reservations leave stock and request IDs unchanged.
- Restricted stock reads to owned tenant and SKU properties.

Only existing production source files were modified.

Verification: the visible test suite passed — **1 test passed, 0 failed**.
